title: What "neo-traditional" means (identity carousel)
hook: People ask what kind of country I make. Here's the honest answer.
body:
Neo-traditional — which is a fancy way of saying I took what Waylon and Merle built and wrote my own songs on top of it. Baritone, steel, and stories that actually happened.

If that's your lane, you're in the right place. Welcome in.
cta: Follow along — plenty more where this came from.
media_notes: Lead slide is the branded card; add 2–4 photos (portrait, on stage, the band) as the rest of the carousel.
